common.credentialNote:
## Setup (once)

**1. Get an Apify token** — __link.apifyTokenUrl__

**2. Create the n8n credential**
Credentials → New → **Header Auth**
- Name: `Apify API`
- Header name: `Authorization`
- Header value: `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`

Every HTTP node here points at that credential by name. No token is stored in this file.
common.costNote:
## Cost

Pay-per-event: from __link.priceFromPer1k__ per 1,000 ads returned ($0.0012 on Free down to $0.0007 on Gold) plus $0.01 per competitor checked in monitor mode. Only ads genuinely new (judged by Google firstShown date) are returned.

Current pricing: __link.actorPricingUrl__

t1.name: Daily competitor Google Ad alerts to Slack
t1.sticky:
# Daily Google Ad Slack Alerts

Runs on a daily schedule in `monitor` mode. Checks competitor domains on the Google Ads Transparency Center and posts a Slack message whenever a competitor launches a genuinely new ad.

__i18n.common.credentialNote__

## Why monitor mode doesn't flood Slack
Google sorts ads by last-shown date, which causes old ads to resurface constantly. This Actor anchors on `firstShown`, so only genuinely new creatives trigger an alert (~0.4 ads per domain per day).

__i18n.common.costNote__

__i18n.common.actorNote__

# Log Competitor Ads to Google Sheets

Monitors competitor advertising campaigns and appends new ad creatives to Google Sheets, including OCR-extracted headlines, descriptions, landing URLs, and active regions.

## Columns in your sheet
`advertiser` · `format` · `headline` · `description` · `display_url` · `first_shown` · `ad_url` · `logged_at`

Runs every Monday at 9 AM. Gathers all newly launched ads across your competitor watch list over the past 7 days, formats an HTML executive digest, and sends it via email.

t4.name: AI Agent tool: what Google ads is a competitor running?
t4.sticky:
# Give an AI Agent access to Google Ads intelligence

Equips an AI Agent with a tool to inspect live and historical Google ads for any competitor domain or advertiser ID. Ask: *"What search ads is Monday.com running right now?"*

__i18n.common.credentialNote__

## OCR & copy coverage
96% of Google text ads exist only as screenshot images. The tool returns OCR-extracted headlines and descriptions with color segmentation, so the LLM can analyze actual ad copy.

__i18n.common.costNote__

__i18n.common.actorNote__
